summary: Full E2E validation of admin one-click deposit refund. Registered throwaway buyer, paid a real Stripe test deposit (EUR 609.90 on car 42317775, session cs_test_a1tzdgsC0FSQbU4uC62wCN6XIIm97vDUiV6aKKlIumTCZm1T66keRzbt4k), refunded via POST /api/admin/deposits/{sid}/refund as signed-in admin, then verified end-to-end: (a) Stripe charge.refunded=true and amount_refunded==6099000 cents with exactly ONE Refund object; (b) car was freed (reserved/reserved_by/reserved_at $unset in Mongo, GET /api/deposit/car reports reserved:false); (c) a DIFFERENT signed-in buyer could POST /api/deposit/checkout for the same car and got 200 with a Stripe URL (previously 409); (d) original buyer's /api/purchases no longer lists the car; (e) double refund returns 409 and does NOT create a second Stripe refund; (f) purchased_listings archive doc + $MEDIA_ROOT/listings/42317775/ survived the refund; (g) admin UI at /en/admin?tab=deposits renders deposits-held, deposits-takings, deposits-refunded stat cards, refunded pill, and archive_ok=false warning pill (data-testid=deposit-archive-warning-<sid>) correctly; (h) /api/admin/deposits and refund route both reject non-admin buyers with 401; (i) car detail page shows detail-reserve-button and hides detail-reserve-taken after refund. 0 defects.
critical_code_review_comments: deposits.refund() correctly uses idempotency_key='deposit-refund-<sid>' so a double click cannot create two Stripe refunds - verified with Stripe API (only 1 Refund object after two POSTs).
The 'already been refunded' Stripe branch is defensive-good: settles the record + frees the car even if the dashboard was used out-of-band.
AdminDeposits.js relies on window.confirm which is fine for a one-off admin action, but note it is not stubbable in Playwright without page.on('dialog'); no user-visible defect.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. Refunded deposit row (session cs_test_a1tzdgsC0FSQbU4uC62wCN6XIIm97vDUiV6aKKlIumTCZm1T66keRzbt4k, car 42317775, EUR 609.90, Stripe refund succeeded) is kept intentionally as history. No paid deposits or reserved cars remain. Synthetic archive_ok=false row was inserted and deleted.
